title: August and the Signal
author: O. M. Thornbury
blurb: Rosalind Amberdale, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
